text:
maya: CI on master is red after the toolchain image roll, looks like linker failures on linux workers. Anyone triage?
ci-bot: Build 5423 failed on linux-x86-64 (target //runtimes/inference:inference_bin) — https://ci.internal/redwood/5423
alex: I'll grab the log and paste the linker snippet I see.
alex: ```
INFO: Linking //runtimes/inference:inference_bin
/usr/bin/ld: /workspace/_solib_k8/_U_S_S_S_C_/external/gcc_toolchain/lib/libstdc++.a: undefined reference to `__cxa_thread_atexit_impl'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
Target //runtimes/inference:inference_bin up-to-date failed to build
``` 
sam: hmm that __cxa_thread_atexit_impl error usually points to mismatched libgcc/libstdc++ or a different linker. We rolled the gcc-toolchain image yesterday, right?
indra: yes, the image tag was bumped to redwood/gcc-toolchain:12.1.0 in the infra/ci-images change (commit b2c9d2f). I started a quick bisect locally and narrowed it to range 7f3a2..b2c9d2f — that bump is the only notable change.
jordan: if that's the case we should pin CI back to the previous image until we validate the new one. Quick mitigation: change the bazel buildkite step to use `redwood/gcc-toolchain:11.4.1` and re-run the failing job.
maya: can someone trigger a rerun with the old image pinned? also maybe add a temporary skip for the flaky test if it's blocking releases.
jordan: done, kicked a rerun with pinned image.
ci-bot: Rerun queued: Build 5424 (triggered by jordan)
buildx: Build 5424 finished — SUCCESS :tada:
alex: good news, the binary links with the pinned image. The new toolchain image probably changed some default ld flags (or pulled in a different libgcc). I'll open a PR to pin until we get a proper fix.
sam: we should also run a canary matrix of the new image against a subset of linux targets (postsubmit) before promoting it. Saves us from full breakage.
indra: agreed. filing an infra task: https://app.internal/tasks/INFRA-311 (placeholder) — will add a checklist: canary job, validation tests, and libstdc++ compatibility check.
maya: alex, can you include the exact failing symbol and the bisect notes in the PR description? that'll help whoever owns the toolchain image.
alex: yup — PR #987 created: "pin gcc-toolchain in CI until compatibility checks added". includes logs and bisect steps.
jordan: also adding a short rollback playbook to eng-infra runbook for future image rollouts.
maya: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for any follow-ups on the flaky `cpu_kv_cache_test` that still failed intermittently on a different runner.
alex: noted, opened a separate issue for the flaky test: https://app.internal/issues/RED-1422
maya: OK closing out on the original link failure — will merge the pin PR if no objections in 30m. :thumbsup:
